## Motivation

Enable flashmla_sparse_q8 DSA backend for prefill on CUDA, import performents for models such as GLM-5.3-Flash.

## Modifications

- Enable `flashmla_sparse_q8` prefill with TileLang decode for GLM-5.3-Flash’s raw FP8 KV layout on SM90, restricted to NoPE models with `kv_lora_rank=512`.
- Allow Q8 prefill to consume KPool top-k indices, including appended live-tail tokens.
- Route raw FP8 paged KV directly to the Q8 kernel using physical KV-pool indices.
- Pad top-k indices to a multiple of 128 with `-1` sentinels, preserving all valid tail tokens.
- Handle zero-dimensional RoPE queries without invoking the concat kernel.
- Preserve the raw 512-byte KV row layout shared by Q8 prefill and TileLang decode.

Depends on CUDA TileLang FP8 KV support from #42957.

## Accuracy Tests
Validated GLM-5.3-Flash on 4 × H200 with flashmla_sparse_q8 and  TileLang prefill .

```bash
sglang serve \
  --model-path /path/to/GLM-5.3-Flash \
  --served-model-name llm \
  --tp-size 4 \
  --mem-fraction-static 0.75 \
  --dsa-prefill-backend flashmla_sparse_q8 \
  --dsa-decode-backend tilelang \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 \
  --moe-runner-backend triton \
  --ep-size 4 \
  --speculative-algorithm EAGLE \
  --speculative-num-steps 5 \
  --speculative-eagle-topk 1 \
  --speculative-num-draft-tokens 6 \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --port 8009 \
  --cuda-graph-backend-prefill breakable \
  --reasoning-parser auto \
  --tool-call-parser auto
```
GSM8K: 1,314 scored questions per run, 5-shot, temperature 0


 | dsa-prefill-backend | Run 1 (rounded) | Run 2 (rounded) | Mean | 
 | -- | -- | -- | -- | 
| tilelang | 95.3% | 95.7% | 95.5% | 
 | flashmla_sparse_q8 | 95.7% | 95.5% | 95.6% | 



## Speed Tests and Profiling

4 × H200, TP4/EP4, TileLang DSA, triton MoE, EAGLE 5/1/6 and Prefill BCG,kv-cache-dtype  fp8_e4m3. Only --dsa-prefill-backend  changes between cases.


dsa-prefill-backend | TTFT (ms) | TPOT (ms) | Output throughput (tok/s)
-- | -- | -- | --
 tilelang|  2437.68 | 24.68 | 859.40
 flashmla_sparse_q8| 1922.94  | 23.40  | 957.61 


## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

Thanks for the detailed review! I’ve addressed the comments and rebased this branch onto main, including #41790.

Changes:
- Added a shared layout predicate for argument validation, backend validation, and KV pool allocation, checking backend pairing and geometry rather than model architecture.
- Restricted raw FP8 support to 512-dim NoPE KV with Q8 prefill and TileLang decode on SM90.
- Removed the PAGED fallback and whole-pool copy. Prefix requests now reuse the RAGGED path and gather the referenced context slots via page_table_1_flattened.
- Removed the redundant top-k padding and NoPE query-preparation branches, reusing the implementations from #41790.
- Restored the packed FP8 KPool guard.
- Updated the GLM-5.3-Flash cookbook and added regression tests.

Validation:
- 49 CPU tests and 29 GPU tests passed, including prefix gathering, live KPool tail tokens, and unsupported-layout rejection.
- The 8 Q8 helper cases also passed after rebuilding with an isolated JIT cache.
- isort and Ruff checks passed.

I also reran GSM8K using sgl-eval with prefix caching enabled on the server:
- 1,319 examples × 2 repeats
- Concurrency: 8
- temperature=0, top_p=1, max_tokens=4096, reasoning_effort=low
- pass@1 (averaged over two repeats): 92.53%
- pass@2: 92.57%
- No-answer, truncation, and request error rates: all 0%

The average input length was 94 tokens, so this GSM8K run is an end-to-end accuracy sanity check rather than evidence of long-prefix Q8 sparse-prefill coverage. The GPU regression tests separately cover prefix gathering and numerical agreement with the reference.

## Motivation

Enable flashmla_sparse_q8 DSA backend for prefill on CUDA, import performents for models such as GLM-5.3-Flash.

## Modifications

- Enable `flashmla_sparse_q8` prefill with TileLang decode for GLM-5.3-Flash’s raw FP8 KV layout on SM90, restricted to NoPE models with `kv_lora_rank=512`.
- Allow Q8 prefill to consume KPool top-k indices, including appended live-tail tokens.
- Route raw FP8 paged KV directly to the Q8 kernel using physical KV-pool indices.
- Pad top-k indices to a multiple of 128 with `-1` sentinels, preserving all valid tail tokens.
- Handle zero-dimensional RoPE queries without invoking the concat kernel.
- Preserve the raw 512-byte KV row layout shared by Q8 prefill and TileLang decode.

Depends on CUDA TileLang FP8 KV support from #42957.

  --ep-size 4 \
  --speculative-algorithm EAGLE \
  --speculative-num-steps 5 \
  --speculative-eagle-topk 1 \
  --speculative-num-draft-tokens 6 \

Thanks for the detailed review! I’ve addressed the comments and rebased this branch onto main, including #41790.

Changes:
- Added a shared layout predicate for argument validation, backend validation, and KV pool allocation, checking backend pairing and geometry rather than model architecture.
- Restricted raw FP8 support to 512-dim NoPE KV with Q8 prefill and TileLang decode on SM90.
- Removed the PAGED fallback and whole-pool copy. Prefix requests now reuse the RAGGED path and gather the referenced context slots via page_table_1_flattened.
- Removed the redundant top-k padding and NoPE query-preparation branches, reusing the implementations from #41790.
- Restored the packed FP8 KPool guard.
- Updated the GLM-5.3-Flash cookbook and added regression tests.

- 49 CPU tests and 29 GPU tests passed, including prefix gathering, live KPool tail tokens, and unsupported-layout rejection.
- The 8 Q8 helper cases also passed after rebuilding with an isolated JIT cache.
- isort and Ruff checks passed.

- 1,319 examples × 2 repeats

- temperature=0, top_p=1, max_tokens=4096, reasoning_effort=low
- pass@1 (averaged over two repeats): 92.53%
- pass@2: 92.57%
- No-answer, truncation, and request error rates: all 0%

The average input length was 94 tokens, so this GSM8K run is an end-to-end accuracy sanity check rather than evidence of long-prefix Q8 sparse-prefill coverage. The GPU regression tests separately cover prefix gathering and numerical agreement with the reference.
